snippet.title: Heroic Aegisio: Origins Official Trailer
snippet.description:
A strategic multiplayer tower defense game where players build synergistic towers, trade resources, and coordinate with teammates to overcome challenging enemy waves.

Join the game now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3675930/Heroic_Aegisio_Origins
Server Opening Times:
- Vietnam (UTC+7): 10:00 PM, September 9, 2025
- Korea (UTC+9): 12:00 AM, September 10, 2025
- Russia (Moscow, UTC+3): 6:00 PM, September 9, 2025
- China (UTC+8): 11:00 PM, September 9, 2025
- USA (PST, UTC-7): 8:00 AM, September 9, 2025

Learn more:
Discord: https://discord.gg/4JDqWZRVBU
